data.title: 春原瞬 · 居室烛光下的黑丝绒睡裙
data.description: 梅花园后院静谧雅致的卧室内，红烛摇曳流淌出温暖香气。瞬身穿黑色高开衩真丝绒吊带睡裙坐在雕花木榻上，黑亮如丝的及腰长发垂落在饱满白皙的胸脯前。头顶毛茸茸的虎耳因动情而微微泛粉轻颤，她抬起修长玉指轻拢鬓发，琥珀色美眸中流波荡漾，展现出成熟大姐姐极致的温存与包容诱惑。
data.action: sitting on wooden carved daybed, black velvet high-slit lingerie nightdress, tiger ears flushed pink, twisting hair strand, deep affectionate mature gaze at viewer
data.location: traditional oriental master bedroom with carved rosewood furniture and red candles
data.lighting: intense warm amber candlelight dancing across glossy silk and bare skin
data.mood: breathtaking mature sensuality, tender devoted maternal passion
data.promptProse: Seated upon an antique rosewood daybed in warm candlelight, Sunohara Shun wears a black silk velvet nightdress with a high side slit. Her tiger ears twitch softly as her green eyes gaze forward with deep, pampering affection.
data.animaCaption: Shun sitting on a carved daybed in a black velvet nightdress with twitching tiger ears.
